title: deferred writeback allocator and fuzzy-pin block reuse
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: reduce end-to-end cold-miss latency and lower tail p99 for KV lookups during bursty traffic while preserving throughput for steady-state workloads. This PR introduces a deferred-writeback allocator for paged KV blocks and a lightweight "fuzzy-pin" mechanism that biases reuse towards recently evicted pages without hard pinning. The deferred-writeback design batches dirty-page flushes to background worker threads so the fast-path allocation/eviction avoids synchronous disk/remote persist stalls; fuzzy-pin attaches a compact recency score to blocks to guide selection in the reuse path and helps avoid repeated thrashing on transient hot prefixes. Design highlights: 1) new deferred_writeback module implements a lock-free writeback queue per allocator shard with backpressure signals to avoid unbounded memory growth; writeback batches are coalesced by object-id and max latency bound (configurable). 2) allocator core refactor extracts a thin Policy trait; two implementations are provided: LRU-like baseline and FuzzyPin that tracks a 8-bit recency counter and a 1-bit soft-pin flag. 3) Eviction now exposes a try_reuse(path) fast-path that returns recently-deallocated blocks to the requester if the recency score exceeds a threshold; otherwise the block is enqueued for deferred writeback and made available after the writeback completes. 4) Integration with scheduler: allocation requests can mark priority; high-priority requests are allowed to preempt non-pinned candidates. 5) Telemetry: new metrics around writeback_batch_size, fuzzy_pin_hits, soft_pin_conflicts, and allocator_reuse_latency. Testing and validation: unit tests for race-free enqueue/dequeue in deferred writeback, fuzz tests for edge-case recency wraparound, and an integration harness that replays production KV traces (trace replay harness added under perf/trace-replays) to validate p50/p95/p99 improvements. Benchmarks: see bench_results field for numbers. Rollout plan: staged rollout - enable FuzzyPin behind runtime feature-flag in Canary and Dedicated, observe writeback latency and reuse-hit metrics for 48 hours, then flip default in 2.0.x branch. Rollback: feature flag and allocator policy knob allow immediate revert without data migration. Related: builds on discussions in ENG-5124 and complements earlier paged-kv reallocator work. This description intentionally keeps implementation detail high level; code comments explain invariants for concurrent writeback/shard ownership.
commits_summary: 7 commits: initial refactor extracting Policy trait; add deferred_writeback worker and queue; implement fuzzy-pin policy; integrate try_reuse fast-path; add telemetry and unit tests; add perf replay harness and benchmarks; docs and changelog updates.
review_comments: Ethan Cole: Can you clarify how the deferred writeback guarantees durability order for dependent objects? If object B references A we must ensure A's writeback is ordered first. Response: We keep intra-shard sequence numbers and coalesce by object group; background worker orders batches by smallest sequence number and emits per-group flushes, documented in code comments and covered by new unit test (ordered_writeback).

Marina Novak: The fuzzy-pin recency counter is 8-bit; how do we avoid pathological wraparound on long-lived workloads? Response: counters decay via periodic right-shift and aggressive decrement when memory pressure is detected; fuzz tests cover multiple wrap scenarios. Added configurable decay interval.

Owen Park: I see a 2% perf regression on steady-state throughput in perf CI when writeback batch size is small. Suggest an adaptive batch size. Response: added adaptive batch sizing based on queue latency and observed pending bytes; perf run after change shows regression resolved.
Marina Novak: approve after addressing adaptive batching and adding dashboard visuals for fuzzy_pin_hits and writeback_queue_depth. Author: thanks — pushed dashboard and updated metrics registry.
ci_checks: perf-regression: pass (p50 -5%, p95 -8%, p99 -12% on kv_hotspot trace)
bench_results: kv_hotspot replay (1k rps bursts): p50 reduced from 1.8ms to 1.2ms (~33% improvement)
kv_hotspot replay: p95 reduced from 9.4ms to 6.1ms (~35% improvement)
kv_hotspot replay: p99 reduced from 32ms to 28ms (~12.5% improvement)
steady-state throughput: unchanged within noise (+0.5%) after adaptive batching
merge_details: Merged by Marina Novak via squash-merge. Commit message: 'allocator: deferred writeback and fuzzy-pin policy to reduce KV cold-miss latency and p99.'
release_notes: Add deferred writeback allocator and fuzzy-pin reuse policy for paged KV blocks. Improves cold-miss and tail latency for bursty workloads; configurable via allocator.policy=fuzzy_pin and allocator.deferred_writeback.enabled=true. No data migration required. Rollout behind feature flag.
